name: Verified arithmetic
description: Solve multi-step numerical word problems using a calculator and independent checks.
body: Extract given quantities without inventing values. Identify operations and build a bounded arithmetic expression. Call the calculator, inspect its returned value, then verify units and a rough magnitude before submitting. Never copy a number as an answer merely because it appears in the problem.

name: Rates and proportions
description: Handle percentages, per-unit rates, ratios and time-distance conversions.
body: Convert percentages to fractions; distinguish percent change from percentage points. Align numerator and denominator units before multiplying a rate by a quantity. For a ratio, identify the common scale and explicitly compute each component using calculator results.

name: Inventory ledger
description: Track purchases, sales, returns and remaining counts over several events.
body: Create a running ledger: start plus incoming amounts minus outgoing amounts. Handle transfers without double counting. Express the ledger as one arithmetic calculation, inspect the calculator output, and check that the resulting remaining count agrees with the event sequence.

name: Money and costs
description: Compute totals, unit prices, profit, discounts and currency-denominated values.
body: Separate revenue, cost and profit; apply discounts to the appropriate base. Multiply quantity by per-unit cost before summing line items. Retain decimal precision until the last step, use the calculator and check whether the requested answer is dollars, cents or a count.

name: Time and repetition
description: Solve elapsed-time, calendar and repeated-production arithmetic.
body: Translate each duration to consistent units, count complete repetitions carefully and handle remainder time separately. Add intervals without counting shared endpoints twice. Use a calculator for the numeric expression and validate its output against a simple boundary case.
